design_specification.subject: one shallow folded ink paper saddle with a single coral turned edge
design_specification.idea: A fragment gains substance: one stiff paper slip with a clear central pleat.
design_specification.construction: Compact width-to-height about 1.15. Two unequal broad facets rise to one low central ridge. Nearly frontal viewpoint, square-cut left edge and one broad right corner turned up to reveal a coral reverse. The two open edges stay visually separate, with a generous paper-colored gap, no tiny curled tips.
design_specification.color: Ink main surface, coral reverse confined to right turned edge; warm paper full square background.
design_specification.material: Matte heavy paper, very shallow relief and one broad upper-left light. Smooth large tonal fields, no fine grain, plastic swelling or cast shadow outside the object.
design_specification.reference: Attached repository artwork is a material reference only: broad soft lighting and shallow fold. Do not copy its heart/leaf outline, green color, botanical identity or surface stippling.
design_specification.small_size: At 32px retain the asymmetric folded contour and visible coral edge; texture is not identity.
design_specification.difference: One physical object with depth, unlike both flat structural marks.
design_specification.risk: Lighting may erase the fold or coral edge; retain broad contour and clear color boundary.
